nodes.label: Zero subagent compiler policy
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-26 - c9a-error-codes-registry [ses_f20bafe9dffeee7Y4FDbWh6x5m].md:L38] "ABSOLUTE HARD RULE - YOU MUST NOT COMPILE ANYTHING": never cargo, rustc, clippy, nextest, mold or rustfmt on this host or on vps-bcb, directly or via a script, because the host is memory-constrained and interactive and local compilation risks a hard reset. The parent runs every compile; L6869 records that verification was git show, grep, sed -n, awk, perl and python3 only.

nodes.label: Proving RED without a compiler by grepping the HEAD content the new test asserts against
nodes.norm_label: proving red without a compiler by grepping the head content the new test asserts against
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-26 - c9a-error-codes-registry [ses_f20bafe9dffeee7Y4FDbWh6x5m].md:L6866] With no compiler available, RED was shown by scripting the completeness.test.ts regexes over git show HEAD content: all 9 vault literals still present at HEAD so an absence assertion fails, and 0 of the 39 new codes present at HEAD so a presence assertion fails. Both tests are include_str! source-scanners, so the same two probes read as GREEN afterwards.

nodes.label: A false gate: a CLI flag that is declared, cited by a plan step as verification, and never implemented
nodes.norm_label: a false gate: a cli flag that is declared, cited by a plan step as verification, and never implemented
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-25 - review-verification-contract [ses_f269c4bdeffevHw106pYGSCWT5].md:L7689] scripts/para_migrate.py:72 declares --check-manifest and never uses it, vault_lint.py:159 declares --schema-only and never uses it, and --self-test only prints ok; three plan steps cite these as their verification. L7728 states the rule that no plan step may cite a flag that returns 0 unconditionally, and L7783 prefers removing a false gate over documenting it.

The note's stated reason for treating this as more than a doc nit: two different gates under one name is a reconciliation defect.
